title: Red Allen the teaser and Holmes's friend
summary: Red teased everyone to tears but never Holmes, who believes you only kid people you like.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: Well, Red was a big needler in that band, wasn't he?

Oh, he was a big needler, believe me. And he could needle, too. He could needle you. He had some of them up there crying sometimes! He would actually make them men cry. But lucky me...lucky me... He never said anything to me. We didn't kid. Red and I didn't kid. I was his boy. I don't know why he liked me. But he liked me; he said he did anyway -- I had no reason not to believe him. And we never kidded. We never played, you know. He kidded and played with everybody else, but he didn't play with me. But he'd take me with him to different places, and here, there or the other. I was his buddy. We went around bars together, and so forth, and this-that-and-the-other. But he never played with me. I mean, we never kidded.

Because I didn't believe in kiddin'. You see, when I kid with somebody, I actually like them. I have to like them to kid them. If I didn't like them... If there was anything about them I didn't like, I would not kid them, because kiddin' brings on violence. And I've always been too small to fight. Heh-heh. But I mean, if I didn't like somebody, I would never kid them. For me to kid with somebody, I have to like them extremely well. But Red and I, we never kidded.

You know, Red was a fine guy. Man, he was kiddin' everybody else -- and I was enjoying it at the expense of somebody else! Yeah, we went through some experiences together. Red was fine, believe me. Everybody liked Red. Everybody liked him. Most people, when they're loud and... you know what I mean?...got a big mouth and loud, and this-that-and-other -- people don't like them. But everywhere we went, everybody goes, "Red Allen! Red Allen!" They'd be shoutin' for Red. And he liked it, too. He liked that. Well, I wasn't so much for that. He liked it.
